description: StarCi Academy backend — port offset registry + stack metadata. Host port = basePorts.<name> + portOffset. starci is the ROOT project so portOffset is 0 and it keeps the standard ports; sibling projects offset away from it (miamia = 69).<name> + portOffset. This file is the ONLY source of truth for ports: compose fragments interpolate them and scripts/sync.mjs writes them into the generated env bridge. NOTE: this is NOT .mount/config/metadata.json, which is i18n content read by the app.

data.description: Private seed-content repo (courses, coding problems, achievements, changelog, advertisements, mock-interview-eq). Replaces .mount/data. No "ref" on purpose: clone the repo default branch.
